_doc: How dune-hd inventory sorts DUNE.DAT's art into review classes, and which palette shows each sheet's sprites when the sheet has none of its own. First matching rule wins (sheet names without .HSQ; a trailing * matches any suffix). Talking heads (sheets with a head layout) and rooms (dune-run --rooms) are found automatically. palette: 'sheet' (its own chunks), 'game' (the palette of the room named by game_palette_room), 'SKYDN:N' / 'SKY:N' (time-of-day palette block N, 0 = day; several are laid in order with +, e.g. 'SKYDN:0+SKY:0').

rules.note: desert views: grey in the DAT, coloured by time of day
village and greenhouse views: coloured by SKY.HSQ time-of-day palettes
intro subtitles: text pre-rendered on its background; built-in upscaler
drawn into rooms; reviewed through the room plates
